title: Northstar SaaS operating structure
goal: Show functional leadership, delivery teams, and a product matrix report.

rubric.must: Maya Ortiz is visibly the CEO at the top of the hierarchy.
Engineering, Product, and Revenue VPs visibly report to the CEO.
Platform, product-engineering, sales, and customer-success teams are visibly nested beneath their functional leaders.
A clearly dashed line labelled Product leadership connects the product VP and group product manager.
Names, titles, and departments remain readable without collisions.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the orgchart/tree exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows Maya Ortiz as CEO above the Engineering, Product, and Revenue VPs. Their teams are nested beneath the corresponding leaders, and a dashed line labeled “Product leadership” connects Clara James to Owen Price. Names, titles, and departments are readable, with no material collisions or cropping.

items.evidence: Maya Ortiz, Chief Executive Officer, appears at the top of the hierarchy.
Evan Chen, Clara James, and Daniel Ross appear beneath the CEO, connected by solid reporting lines.
Platform and Product Engineering teams are nested under Evan Chen; Sales and Customer Success are nested under Daniel Ross.
A dashed line labeled “Product leadership” connects Clara James to Owen Price.
Names, titles, and department labels are legible; no material overlaps or cropping are visible.
